description: Creates a new Normal or Cloze note type from ordered fields, complete card templates, and shared CSS. Optionally selects its Browser sort field in AnkiConnect v1. Defaults to dry-run mode and does not create notes or cards.

css.description: Shared CSS for every card generated from the note type

dryRun.description: When true, validate and preview the note type without creating it

fields.description: Field names in their desired order. The first field is used for duplicate checks.

items.description: New field name. Anki special field names such as Tags, Type, Deck, Card, and FrontSide are not allowed.

isCloze.description: Whether to create an Anki Cloze note type

modelName.description: Unique name for the new Anki note type

sortField.description: Exact name from fields. Requires AnkiConnect v1. Omit to use Anki's default first field.

back.description: Complete HTML for the back side

front.description: Complete HTML for the front side

name: create-note-type

designHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the current CSS and card templates

schemaHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the ordered note-type field names

sortField.description: Proposed or verified Browser sort field; null in legacy mode.

title: Create note type
